knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A premium session is described by length, technique and products, and does not promise a health outcome. Health claims are not supported by the sources in this course.
A premium price must never remove the contraindication check or the consent step.
The lesson says the price should cover the intake and consent time, the set-up and clean-down, the products, the linen, the travel and the cost of any compliance step.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks that a sample premium price is built from time, skill, products, linen, travel and compliance costs
Assessor checks that a sample advertisement contains no health outcome claim
Assessor checks that a sample membership record shows each session with its own intake and consent
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Price build sheet for the premium session
Sample membership record with the session entries
stopWorkCriteria: A health outcome claim is published without a source
A membership session proceeds without an intake and consent record
